text: Added MultivarEstimator.Cpca, FitArtifactKind.Cpca, and FitArtifact.CpcaArtifact. CpcaEstimatorSpec now exposes requested-component summaries and upper bounds; MultivarPlan validation checks CPCA metrics, constraints, selected blocks, and requested ranks per ROI. Also added the local executor branch while wiring the artifact so the enum path is executable. Verified with sbt "multivarJVM/testOnly scalafim.multivar.PlanSuite" and sbt "multivarJVM/test" "multivarJS/test".
